products.name: Y'allternative Living Tank Top
products.blurb: Same rainbow stag, same crescent moon, cut for the hottest days of the year. Soft triblend racerback built to be worn hard and washed easy. Original artwork, not something pulled off a mass-print catalog.

products.name: Y'allternative Living Unisex T-Shirt
products.blurb: The shirt that started the whole shop: a rainbow stag under a crescent moon, screen-printed on soft cotton cut to actually fit everybody. Original artwork, zero mass-production. Wear it to the market, wear it to Pride, wear it everywhere in between.

products.name: Y'all Heal Now Miracle Frankincense Salve
products.blurb: One little tin, a whole lot of jobs: dry cuticles, cracked heels, windburn, razor bumps. Whatever's rough, this goes on it. Calendula, arnica, and five essential oils in a beeswax-shea base, mixed by hand in a 2 oz tin in Landrum, SC.
ingredients: Essential Oils (Lavender, Tea Tree, Frankincense, Rosemary, Chamomile)
products.ingredientsNote: Now made with almond oil (a tree nut). Not recommended if you have a nut allergy.

products.name: Y'allternative Miracle Balm
products.blurb: No essential oils, no fragrance, nothing to react to. Just a rich little .5 oz balm for lips, cuticles, and anywhere skin needs backup. Gentle enough for the whole family, kids included.
products.ingredientsNote: No essential oils, no added fragrance.

products.name: Hush Y'all Magnesium Arnica Sleep Salve
products.blurb: Rub a little onto your feet or shoulders before bed and let lavender, chamomile, and cedarwood take it from there. Magnesium and arnica in a 2 oz tin, built for overthinkers and night owls who need the day to actually end.
ingredients: Essential Oils (Lavender, Cedarwood, Chamomile, Orange, Frankincense)

products.name: Bourbon Beard Salve
products.blurb: A 2 oz tin that softens coarse facial hair, calms the itch underneath, and smells like a stiff drink and cedarwood instead of a drugstore aisle. Light hold, zero grease, genuinely good gift material.

products.name: Shimmer Body Oil
products.blurb: Cedarwood, sweet orange, and patchouli under a black-gold shimmer that photographs as good as it feels. That's the Seduction blend, one of three scents this comes in. Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and built for festivals, Pride, and anywhere else you plan on shining harder than everyone around you.

products.name: Lavender Shea Body Butter
products.blurb: Deep Shea Rest, whipped thick with raw African shea and a lavender-forward blend underneath. Massage it into damp skin after your shower and let it work on cracked heels and winter-dry patches while you sleep. Built as a night ritual, not just a lotion.

products.name: Bourbon Vanilla Hand Scrub
products.blurb: Pumice, pink salt, and sugar for the grease and grime; coconut and olive oil so your hands don't pay for it. A 2 oz tin built for hands that work for a living.

products.name: Lavender Epsom Salt Soak
products.blurb: Relaxation with a side of rebellion: lavender, black pepper, and rosemary dissolved into a 10 oz bag of Epsom salt and baking soda. Run the bath, toss in a scoop, take up all the space you want.

products.name: Backroad Recovery Epsom Salt Soak
products.blurb: Peppermint, lavender, black pepper, and ylang ylang for whatever the backroads (or the day) put you through. Stir a scoop into a warm bath, soak 20 to 30 minutes, come out looser than you went in.
ingredients: Essential Oils (Peppermint, Lavender, Black Pepper, Ylang Ylang)

products.name: Protection Potion Keychain
products.blurb: A mini spell jar, wax-sealed and clipped to a sturdy keyring. Pick your blend below. Five inches of everyday witchy armor for your keys, bag, or backpack.
products.ingredientsNote: Exact salt/herb blend varies by the option you choose above.

options.label: Black Lava & Pink Himalayan Salt (Protection + Self Love)

products.name: Bug Off B*tch Natural Bug Spray
products.blurb: Tell the mosquitoes to buzz off, naturally. Citronella, lemongrass, and five other essential oils in a 2 oz amber spray, no DEET, no sticky residue, just Southern summer survival.
ingredients: Essential Oils (Citronella, Lemongrass, Peppermint, Tea Tree, Lavender, Rosemary)

products.name: Y'all Means All Sugar Scrub
products.blurb: Rainbow layers of sweet exfoliant that slough off the rough, leave skin soft, and look like a Pride parade in a jar. Glitter-and-grit self-care that means exactly what it says: everybody's welcome.

products.name: Y'all Means All Rainbow Whipped Body Butter
products.blurb: Whipped light and fluffy in a citrus-peach blend, with rainbow swirls that mean all of it: every color, every one of us. Melts in without the grease and keeps skin soft all day. Everybody's welcome, moisturized.

products.name: Appalachian Rain Clearing Mist
products.blurb: White sage, cedar, and sweetgrass in a fine mist: two pumps at the doorway after a hard conversation, a house guest who overstayed, or just a Monday that won't quit. Inspired by Appalachian folk tradition, no smoke, no residue, no landlord complaints. Amber glass, small-batch blended in Landrum, SC.
ingredients: Essential Oils (White Sage, Cedar, Sweetgrass, Rosemary)
products.ingredientsNote: Shake gently before each use. Mist doorways, corners, or yourself: anywhere the energy feels stuck. Safe around pets when dry.

products.name: Moonlit Meadow Bath Tea
products.blurb: Dried lavender, chamomile, rose petals, and oat straw in a reusable muslin bag. Drop it in a warm bath, let it steep five minutes, soak until the day stops mattering. Gentler on your tub than loose herbs, and the bag's good for two or three rounds before you compost the whole thing.
products.ingredientsNote: Comes with a reusable organic cotton muslin bag. Each bag is good for 2–3 soaks. Compost when spent.

products.name: Porch Sweep Clearing Mist
products.blurb: Named for the old Southern habit of sweeping the porch at dusk to clear out the day's trouble. Lemongrass, palo santo, and black tourmaline-infused water in a 4 oz amber bottle. Mist your space after an argument, a bad day, or just because the vibes are off.

products.name: Digital Gift Card
products.description: The perfect gift for the black sheep & bold hearts. Choose any amount from $10 to $500. No expiration date, delivered straight to their inbox.
products.blurb: Can't decide what they'd love? Let them pick. Delivered by email, ready to use on anything in the shop.

bundles.name: Grit & Grace Starter Set
bundles.blurb: The essential trio for anyone navigating life south of the Mason-Dixon: the do-everything salve folks keep re-ordering, the bourbon-vanilla scrub that gets your hands actually clean, and the bug spray nobody admits they need until August. Three of our most-reviewed goods, one easy yes.

bundles.name: Bourbon & Grit Gift Set
bundles.blurb: Scent-matched on purpose. The beard salve softens the scruff; the hand scrub takes the grease off whatever he was working on. Both in the same bourbon, vanilla and cedarwood, so it reads as one gift, not two things from two different aisles.

bundles.name: Backwoods Burnout Recovery Kit
bundles.blurb: For unwinding after the kind of days that leave you running on fumes: massage the lavender shea butter into damp skin after a shower, then work the magnesium sleep salve into feet and shoulders and let lavender, chamomile and cedarwood take it from there. Built for night owls and overthinkers.

bundles.name: Y'all Means All Pride Set
bundles.blurb: The flagship rainbow-stag tee plus the shimmer oil built for exactly this: festivals, Pride, and anywhere you plan on shining harder than everyone around you. Pull the 'Y'all Means All' scent and wear the whole thing to the parade. Queer at the root, year-round.

bundles.name: Everyday Armor Kit
bundles.blurb: Everyday witchy armor, boxed up: a wax-sealed protection spell jar for your keys, the bug spray that tells mosquitoes to buzz off, naturally, and a lavender soak for taking up all the space you want in the tub. Grit and glitter for the ones who need it.

bundles.name: Gentle Landing Set
bundles.blurb: A soft place to land: the unscented, essential-oil-free Miracle Balm for wherever skin needs backup, paired with our raw-shea body butter for everywhere else. For new parents, sensitive skin, and anybody having a rough go.

bundles.name: Discovery Flight
bundles.blurb: Can't decide? Try a little of everything. Four of our bestselling products bundled together at 15% off: the salve everybody re-orders, the bourbon-vanilla scrub, a lavender soak, and the bug spray that actually works. A full tour of the shop in one box.

faq.question: Where do you ship from?
faq.answer: Straight out of Landrum, SC. Processing time isn't the same for every item, so check the product description for the specifics before you order.

faq.question: What's your return policy?
faq.answer: Opened salves, scrubs, and soaks are final sale for hygiene reasons. Unworn apparel and sealed items can be exchanged. Anything arrive wrong or damaged? Email us and we'll make it right.

faq.question: Do you have unscented or sensitive-skin options?
faq.answer: We do. The Y'allternative Miracle Balm is unscented and essential-oil-free, made for skin that side-eyes fragrance.

faq.question: Can I get something custom or in bulk?
faq.answer: Yep. Email us or send an Instagram DM with what you're picturing (gifts, market swag, wedding favors, whatever) and we'll figure it out together.

faq.question: Where can I meet you in person?
faq.answer: Farmers markets and Pride events around Upstate SC and beyond. Check out our [events page](events.html) or follow our socials so you know exactly where and when we'll be set up next.

faq.question: Do you offer free shipping?
faq.answer: Yes! We offer free shipping on all orders over $40. It will automatically apply at checkout.

faq.question: What is the shelf life of your salves and soaks?
faq.answer: Since our products are all-natural and preservative-free, we recommend using them within 6 to 12 months for the best potency and freshness. Keep them in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
